rule: A package counts as done only with actual code and recorded test output; privileged and paid runs are listed under not_executed.

readout training on real task outcomes (no failed verification in 54 training runs, so no labeled decision of either class)
evaluation of a readout policy in protocol 4b (no candidate existed)
weight training (outside G1-G3 by the blueprint)
native PSE worker in the routing experiment (integrated afterwards; see PSE)
a second provider

release_scope_G1.scope: single host (Linux 6.18 x86_64, uid 0, util-linux unshare/setpriv), one real provider (gpt-4.1-mini), fifteen synthetic repository-repair tasks in five families; AT17 executed under three frozen protocols without an established advantage over the simple verification loop; AT18 restore bundle executed; Apache-2.0 root license

release_scope_G2.scope: one owner/scheduler/policy build served repository repair, source-grounded document amendment and numerical transformation (fixture tasks, real provider for the valid tasks, scripted invalid and out-of-scope controls) with registered domain observers, independent oracles and recorded replay; the analytical workers are the standard-library adapter and, since ADR-18, the native PSE graph engine built from the locked sources and run as a contained worker with independent references (evidence/pse); the advantage gate was executed on the document and numerical families under protocol 5 (evidence/wp14) and not passed, with the declared ablations of provenance-aware retrieval and the revision rule below the declared minimum relevant effect

release_scope_G3.scope: not established: the routing feature experiment ran under frozen protocols on the hard tier (54 training runs with two providers, 72 evaluation runs with gpt-4.1-mini, stateful family held out) but no first patch failed verification, so no labeled router decision exists and no readout candidate could be trained or evaluated; the episodic-retrieval ablation reached equal verified success on the held-out family with no false completion at 68 percent more model tokens and failed its declared criterion; the rule-based policy without episodes remains the pinned default
